Small packets are sent to keep mappings on NAT routers alive if there is no other traffic. In order to save energy the default interval is 45 seconds. Behind NAT routers that remove mappings early this might be too high, try 20 seconds or less in that case.

Certificate requests are sent for all available or selected CA certificates. To reduce the size of the IKE_AUTH message this can be disabled. However, this only works if the server sends its certificate even if it didn\'t receive any certificate requests.
Use the Online Certificate Status Protocol (OCSP), if available, to check that the server certificate has not been revoked.
Use Certificate Revocation Lists (CRL), if available, to check that the server certificate has not been revoked. CRLs are only used if OCSP doesn\'t yield a result.
In strict mode the authentication will fail not only if the server certificate has been revoked but also if its status is unknown (e.g. because OCSP failed and no valid CRL was available).
Use the stronger PSS encoding instead of the classic PKCS#1 encoding for RSA signatures. Authentication will fail if the server does not support such signatures.

Use IPv6 for outer transport addresses if available. Can only be enabled if UDP encapsulation for IPv6 is supported by the server. Note that the Linux kernel only supports this since version 5.8, so many servers will not support it yet.

By default, the client will route all network traffic through the VPN, unless the server narrows the subnets when the connection is established, in which case only traffic the server allows will be routed via VPN (by default, all other traffic is routed as if there was no VPN).

Optionally configure specific algorithms to use for IKEv2 and/or IPsec/ESP instead of the defaults. Refer to our wiki for a list of algorithm identifiers (note that not all are supported by this app). Both fields take a list of algorithms, each separated by a hyphen.

For non-AEAD/classic encryption algorithms, an integrity algorithm, a pseudo random function (optional, defaults to one based on the integrity algorithm) and a Diffie-Hellman group are required (e.g. aes256-sha256-ecp256). For combined-mode/AEAD algorithms, the integrity algorithm is omitted but a PRF is required (e.g. aes256gcm16-prfsha256-ecp256).

For non-AEAD/classic encryption algorithms, an integrity algorithm is required, a Diffie-Hellman group is optional (e.g. aes256-sha256 or aes256-sha256-ecp256). For combined-mode/AEAD algorithms, the integrity algorithm is omitted (e.g. aes256gcm16 or aes256gcm16-ecp256). If a DH group is specified IPsec SA rekeying will use a DH key exchange. However, DH groups specified here are not used when the connection is established initially because the keys there are derived from the IKE SA key material. Therefore, any configuration mismatch with the server will only cause errors later during rekeying.

Three protocols, one app. Tap a section below to learn how everything works.

• Open the tab you want: IKEv2, sing-box or AmneziaWG.
• Add a server: use Get free servers in the menu, or the Get server button on the AmneziaWG tab.
• Tap a profile card to connect. A green dot and green name show the active connection.
• Tap the same card again, or the disconnect button at the top, to stop.
• Only one connection can be active at a time. Starting another one disconnects the previous one automatically.

• IKEv2: a fast, stable classic VPN that works well on most networks.\n• sing-box: a flexible engine that supports links such as VLESS, VMess, Trojan and Shadowsocks, with options like TLS, Reality and different transports. A good choice on filtered networks.\n• AmneziaWG: WireGuard with traffic obfuscation, very fast and light. Useful where plain WireGuard is blocked.

• IKEv2 and sing-box: open the menu and tap "Get Free Server." Note that only the servers with a flag next to their name are unfiltered; IKEv2 and sing-box servers are filtered. So use the ones with flags (such as the Germany flag) to get a server and connect, or turn on another auxiliary VPN first, and then you can get a server from the first two.
• AmneziaWG: in its own tab, tap the "Get Server" button. Note that this server may also be filtered for you when you get it, so you must be connected to a VPN to get a server from this protocol. This server gives you a config based on your location—for example, it gives one server for Iran, a different one for India, and another for Germany. So if you got one and couldn't connect, be sure to try getting a server from several different locations. The ping value of this protocol doesn't matter; it just needs to be green, meaning it's active. If a captcha appears, type the letters from the image and confirm.
• Next to each AmneziaWG server, the flag and country name are added automatically. This requires an internet connection once.
• Later, you can also manually change the profile using the edit button on the card.

• The ping button at the top tests every server in the current tab. The fastest ones move to the top.
• Disconnect before pinging, otherwise the result is not reliable.
• Menu, Delete servers without ping removes the servers that did not answer. You can choose IKEv2, sing-box or AmneziaWG. Run a ping first.
• AmneziaWG uses a normal ICMP ping. A few servers block it but still work, so check before deleting them.

• Share: sends the profile as text. IKEv2 gives a profile file text, sing-box gives its link, AmneziaWG lets you pick an Amnezia key (vpn://) or a .conf config.
• Edit: change the name, server, keys and other settings.
• Delete: removes the profile after you confirm.
• Press and hold a card to select several profiles and copy or delete them together.

• Menu, Backup saves the profiles of all three protocols into one file.\n• Restoring adds the profiles from a file and skips the ones you already have.\n• Keep the backup somewhere safe, it contains your server keys and passwords.

• On first launch the app asks for notification permission and to ignore battery optimization. Please allow both so the connection is not killed in the background.\n• While connected, the notification shows the state, the speed and a disconnect button.\n• If the connection drops when the screen is off, open the phone settings and set the battery mode of this app to unrestricted.

• Connected but no internet: try another server or another protocol.
• AmneziaWG stays on connecting: the server may be down or blocked. Run a ping and pick another server.
• Wrong captcha: request the server again to get a new image.
• No flag next to a server: connect to the internet and reopen the AmneziaWG tab.
• If the app crashes, the next launch shows a report. Press Copy and send it to the developer.

• Pick the server with the lowest ping and the best stability, not only the lowest number.
• If one protocol is blocked on your network, switch to another one.
• Keep the app updated from the menu, Check for updates.
• Free servers can get crowded. Having several saved servers gives you a backup plan.
